tools.name: get_me
tools.description: Return the authenticated OwnerRez user (verifies your credentials). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/users/me.

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: List rental properties. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/properties. Returns the pageable envelope { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Fetch a single property by id (includes time_zone). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/properties/{id}.

tools.name: list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings (reservations). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/bookings. Filter by property, date range, changed-since, and status; opt into embedded charges/guest/tags. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Fetch a single booking by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/bookings/{id}. Opt into embedded charges/guest/tags.

tools.name: list_guests
tools.description: List guests (contacts). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/guests. NOTE: OwnerRez REQUIRES either `q` (search) or `created_since_utc` on this endpoint. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_guest
tools.description: Fetch a single guest (contact) by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/guests/{id}.

tools.name: list_quotes
tools.description: List quotes. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/quotes. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }. Use the `params` passthrough for documented filters (e.g. property_id, guest_id).

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Fetch a single quote by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/quotes/{id}.

tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: List channel listings (a property's presence on a listing site such as Airbnb/Vrbo). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/listings. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Fetch a single channel listing by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/listings/{id}.

tools.name: list_listing_sites
tools.description: List the listing sites (channels, e.g. Airbnb, Vrbo) known to OwnerRez. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/listingsites.

tools.name: list_owners
tools.description: List property owners. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/owners. Returns { items, count, limit, offset, next_page_url }.

tools.name: list_inquiries
tools.description: List guest inquiries (pre-booking leads). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/inquiries. Use `params` for documented filters.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List messages from guest-communication threads. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/messages. Use `params` for documented filters (e.g. booking_id).

tools.name: list_payments
tools.description: List payments. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/payments. Use `params` for documented filters (e.g. booking_id, since_utc).

tools.name: get_payment
tools.description: Fetch a single payment by id. OwnerRez API: GET /v2/payments/{id}.

tools.name: list_field_definitions
tools.description: List custom-field definitions available in the account (the schema for custom fields on properties/bookings/guests). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/fielddefinitions.

tools.name: ownerrez_request
tools.description: Power-user escape hatch: GET any OwnerRez API path not wrapped by a dedicated tool. READ-ONLY — only GET is allowed. Pass the FULL API path after the host, starting with a slash, INCLUDING any query string, e.g. "/v2/propertysearch?query=beach" or "/v2/bookings/123". Returns the parsed JSON.

tools.name: create_guest
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a new guest (contact). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/guests (JSON). Emails/phones/addresses are arrays of objects — pass them via the `fields` passthrough (e.g. email_addresses:[{address:"a@b.com"}]). Returns the created guest.

tools.name: update_guest
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: updates an existing guest. OwnerRez API: PATCH /v2/guests/{id} (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for arrays (email_addresses/phones/addresses) and any other documented field.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a new booking (reservation). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/bookings (JSON). A booking ties a guest to a property for a date range; the exact charge/quote shape is account-specific, so pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created booking.

tools.name: update_booking
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: updates an existing booking. OwnerRez API: PATCH /v2/bookings/{id} (JSON — only included fields change). Use the `fields` passthrough for any documented field (dates, guest counts, notes, status).

tools.name: create_quote
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: creates a quote for a property + date range (the pre-booking pricing document). OwnerRez API: POST /v2/quotes (JSON). The full quote/charge shape is account-specific — pass extra documented fields via `fields`. Returns the created quote.

tools.name: create_message
tools.description: MUTATES OwnerRez data: posts a message into a guest-communication thread. OwnerRez API: POST /v2/messages (JSON). The exact thread/booking linkage is account-specific — pass extra documented fields (e.g. thread_id, booking_id) via `fields`. Returns the created message.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_me" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the authenticated OwnerRez user (verifies your credentials). OwnerRez API: GET /v2/users/me.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_messages · Private data: get_me, list_guests, get_guest, create_guest, create_quote · Public sink: create_guest, create_booking, create_quote, create_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_messages · Private data: get_me, list_guests, get_guest, create_guest, create_quote · Public sink: create_guest, create_booking, create_quote, create_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
